docs.title: ADR-014: Idempotency keys scoped to merchant + amount + 24h
docs.author: Nisha Kapoor
docs.body:
# ADR-014: Idempotency keys scoped to merchant + amount + 24h

System: Ledger Reconciliation

We key ledger writes on (merchant_id, amount_minor, currency, 24h bucket) instead of the gateway request id, because two acquirers retry with different request ids. Using request ids caused double postings.

docs.title: Recon alert handling
docs.author: Arjun Mehta
docs.body:
# Recon alert handling

System: Ledger Reconciliation

When recon_break_count fires on the 1st of the month, silence it for 24 hours. Month-end accruals cause temporary breaks.

tacit.text: 03:40 because the acquirer's late-presentment file lands at 03:15. Moving it earlier silently drops about 0.4% of transactions into the next day and Finance sees phantom breaks.
tacit.question: Why does recon run at 03:40 and not 02:00?

tacit.text: New acquirer = new parser in recon/parsers + a row in recon_overrides + 2 weeks in shadow mode. Never skip shadow mode, the one time we did cost us 3 days of manual matching.
tacit.question: Adding a new acquirer to recon?

tacit.text: If recon shows a mismatch of exactly the FX fee, it's the T+1 rate snapshot. Rerun recon with --fx-snapshot=settlement-date. Don't adjust the ledger by hand.
tacit.question: Recon mismatch equal to the FX fee?

tacit.text: It's noisy on the 1st of every month because of month-end accruals. Silence it for 6 hours on day 1, never longer.
tacit.question: The recon_break_count alert is screaming on the 1st again

tacit.text: Risk's dispute webhook must carry the original ledger txn id, else recon can't link it. v3 of the webhook has it.
tacit.question: Dispute webhook missing the txn id

tacit.text: Tolerance rules live in recon/rules.yaml, but the acquirer-specific overrides are in the DB table recon_overrides, not in the repo. That's on purpose so ops can hotfix.
tacit.question: Where do the recon tolerance rules live?

tacit.text: Warehouse lags recon by one run because the export reads the previous checkpoint. A difference of exactly one day's volume is expected.
tacit.question: Warehouse numbers don't match recon

tacit.text: recon replay --date YYYY-MM-DD --dry-run first. The replay writes to the checkpoint table, so never run two replays at once.
tacit.question: How do I replay a recon day?

conflicts.expert: It's noisy on the 1st of every month because of month-end accruals. Silence it for 6 hours on day 1, never longer.

## Ledger Reconciliation: critical

Nisha holds 75% of the evidence-weighted knowledge of Ledger Reconciliation (tier 1); the strongest remaining person holds 12%. Backups: Rahul Verma 12%, Hassan Ali 4%. Sources: github, jira, slack.

**What they know that is not written down**

- 03:40 because the acquirer's late-presentment file lands at 03:15. Moving it earlier silently drops about 0.4% of transactions into the next day and Finance sees phantom breaks. _( asked by Priya Raman in #payments on 26 Nov 2025 )_
- New acquirer = new parser in recon/parsers + a row in recon_overrides + 2 weeks in shadow mode. Never skip shadow mode, the one time we did cost us 3 days of manual matching. _( asked by Felix Wagner in #payments on 17 Mar 2026 )_
- If recon shows a mismatch of exactly the FX fee, it's the T+1 rate snapshot. Rerun recon with --fx-snapshot=settlement-date. Don't adjust the ledger by hand. _( asked by Priya Raman in #payments on 06 Mar 2026 )_
- It's noisy on the 1st of every month because of month-end accruals. Silence it for 6 hours on day 1, never longer. _( asked by Meera Iyer in #payments on 29 Nov 2025 )_
- Risk's dispute webhook must carry the original ledger txn id, else recon can't link it. v3 of the webhook has it. _( asked by Hassan Ali in #risk-eng on 11 Dec 2025 )_
- Tolerance rules live in recon/rules.yaml, but the acquirer-specific overrides are in the DB table recon_overrides, not in the repo. That's on purpose so ops can hotfix. _( asked by Rahul Verma in #payments on 17 Dec 2025 )_
- Warehouse lags recon by one run because the export reads the previous checkpoint. A difference of exactly one day's volume is expected. _( asked by Rahul Varma in #payments on 26 Oct 2025 )_
- recon replay --date YYYY-MM-DD --dry-run first. The replay writes to the checkpoint table, so never run two replays at once. _( asked by Kenji Watanabe in #payments on 17 Jan 2026 )_
